main.description: An emoji given to a node or a comment, in a context's space or in public. One per person, subject and emoji; taking it back deletes the record.

subject.description: The public record being reacted to.

emoji.description: A single emoji grapheme cluster (the reaction), e.g. an emoji that may itself be a ZWJ sequence.

author.description: Who gave it, when the record is held by the organization for them.

legacyId.description: Its id in the interim, for what was carried over.
